findings: Solved 2026-10-30 on the owner's request (exercises book by book, in Practice): Chapter 18 end-of-chapter exercise as printed on PDF 111-114 (printed pages 111-114), in the book's words and order. The in-text 'Solve the following genetic problem(s)' boxes (PDF 89-108) belong to the topic lessons and are not repeated here.

Counts: Section 1 fifteen MCQs (options a-d), Section 2 sixteen short questions (Q15 'Solve the following genetic problems' i-v as five self-checks worked step by step with Punnett tables; Q16 'Differentiate between' ten pairs, each a separate self-check with a two-column answer table, in the printed order row by row), Section 3 fourteen long questions, six Inquisitive Questions; all solved in English and Roman Urdu.
The book prints no answer key. MCQ keys worked out from the chapter's text: 1c 2b 3c 4d 5d 6d 7b 8d 9b 10b 11a 12d 13b 14d 15c.

Book correction, MCQ 9: no printed option is correct; black coat with straight fur (B_cc) = 3/4 x 1/4 = 3/16. Keyed (b) 9/16 only as the book's likely intended answer (the fraction for black and curly, B_C_); the explanation and a Book correction box give 3/16. Reviewer may prefer to change the key policy. Key review 2026-10-31: key (b) kept; the box now also says which class each printed fraction belongs to.
Book correction, MCQ 1: printed 'winkled-seeded' for wrinkled-seeded; kept as printed with a Book correction box.
Book correction, MCQ 2: option (c) printed '9/1', evidently 9/16; kept as printed with a Book correction box (not the key).
Book correction, Short Q16: pair printed 'XX-XY and XX-ZO sex determination'; should read XX-XO; kept as printed with a Book correction box.
Book correction, Long Q1: printed 'the law independent assortment' (missing 'of'); kept as printed with a Book correction box.

Book correction, MCQ 6 (key review 2026-10-31): no option fits exactly: yellow x white corn giving ears with about equal yellow and white kernels is a 1:1 testcross-type result (each kernel is a separate offspring), while codominance means both alleles show in one heterozygote. Keyed (d) codominance as the book's intended answer (both colours shown, no blending), with a Book correction box in both languages (it replaces the Roman Urdu Wazahat note).
MCQ 12 assumes the woman herself is normal (Aa), as the question implies. MCQ 11: in the chapter only ABO has multiple alleles (Rh: D/d; MN: two alleles), so keyed (a).

Chapter text errors relevant to the answers (already Book corrections in the topic lessons): the woman's baldness genotype printed 'bb' (Long Q11 answer says two baldness alleles; RU Wazahat) and 'a Y carrying egg' in ZZ-ZW (Long Q9; RU Wazahat).

Answers beyond the chapter, labelled: Short Q12 (eye colour as fifth polygenic trait), Long Q14 (recombination frequency for gene mapping), Inquisitive Q3 (alternatives of blood transfusion: whole answer), Inquisitive Q5 (donor's body replaces blood), Inquisitive Q6 (avoiding cousin marriages). Inquisitive Q1 is a data activity: the answer gives the method only, no data invented.

Comparison answers (Short Q7 antigen/antibody table, Q16 ten pairs; Long Q7, Q9) carry answer tables; genetics answers (Short Q15 i-v; Long Q1, Q2, Q5, Q8, Q10, Q12, Q13) carry Punnett or result tables. No figures added. Draft for the academic review.
